title: Mandatary
summary: MAN'DATARY MAN'DATE, noun [Latin mando, to command.] 1. A command; an order, precept or injunction; a commission. This dream all powerful Juno sends; I bear Her mighty mandates, and her words you hear

inlines.v: MAN'DATARY MAN'DATE, noun [Latin mando, to command.] 1. A command; an order, precept or injunction; a commission. This dream all powerful Juno sends; I bear Her mighty mandates, and her words you hear. 2. In canon law, a rescript of the pope, commanding an ordinary collator to put the person therein named in possession of the first vacant benefice in his collation.
